name: Simple game with custom scripting DSL

mentions.name: Simple game with custom scripting DSL
mentions.description: A simple game in development that will support player-written scripts, with the scripting system also used for enemy AI. Instead of using a behavior tree dependency, the author is building a custom DSL with an interpreter, structured as typed builders producing an untyped AST and then a typed IR, with a TypeScript schema driving a codegen build step that emits .ts and .rs files.
mentions.source_excerpt:
>Making a simple game

>Want player scripts to be possible (And dogfood it for enemy ai too)

>Behavior tree dep looks too easy, let's make a dsl + interpreter
